derived_fields.hardness_mohs_x10: parsed only from materials.hardness strings ending in 'Mohs'; ranges (e.g. '6-7 Mohs') use the midpoint; '~' dropped; HB/HV/HRC/Shore/Rockwell values are NOT converted (null). hardness_raw keeps the db string.
derived_fields.resistivity_class: derived from materials.elec_resistivity_ohm_m with thresholds <1e-5 conductor (same cut as tools/crucible_ramps.py), <1e6 semiconductor, else insulator. elements/compounds tables have no resistivity column -> null.
derived_fields.density_kg_m3: materials: rounded as stored; elements/compounds: density_g_cm3*1000 rounded. compounds.density_g_cm3 is NULL for every row in the db.
derived_fields.category: assigned by this export from db class/name (e.g. materials.mat_class metal + alloy name -> alloy); db_class keeps the original

_meta.excluded: materials ids 28-33,35,36 (ABS, HDPE, PVC, Nylon, PTFE, epoxy, CFRP, GFRP); gases; lanthanides; Rb,Cs,Fr,Ra,Po,At,Ac,Pa; acids/caustics/organics among compounds
_meta.no_colour_data: crucible.db holds no appearance/colour data for any material, element or compound
